routesToMount.mountNote: Import as galleryV2Router and call app.use('/', galleryV2Router). All paths self-prefix (/public/portfolio-v2/* and /ai/portfolio-v2/*).

pagesToRegister.note: Enhanced portfolio gallery with search, sort, compare, industry showcase, and Brand DNA recs.
Curated inspiration feed grouped by mood/theme.
Standalone compare tool. Accepts ?ids=1,2,3 query param.

integrationOrder: Team 24 mounts galleryV2Router AFTER existing portfolio-gallery.ts router to avoid path collision.
Team 24 applies migration draft (indexes only, additive, safe to re-run).
knownRisks: Routes /public/portfolio-v2/* must be mounted BEFORE any catch-all route in api-server/src/index.ts.
inspirationFeedService uses LOWER() style matching — case differences in existing data will reduce results.
colorTag JSONB containment query requires GIN index (team-04.sql) for good performance at scale.
BrandDnaRecs widget requires a workspace token — shows nothing for unauthenticated visitors (by design).
CompareDrawer launches from GalleryV2Page; deep-linking via /portfolio-compare?ids= requires Team 24 to wire the route.
